description: This file defines a React functional component called NotesList, which renders a grid of note cards. It receives a list of notes and callback functions for editing and deleting notes as props. It maps over the notes array to generate NoteCard components inside div elements with role designations for accessibility.

methods.name: NotesList({ notes, onEdit, onDelete })
methods.description: Functional React component that renders a list of notes as NoteCard components within a responsive grid.
